Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 2 by incorrectly identifying the director of the film "Thomas Jefferson" as Geoffrey C. Ward. The WebSurfer results in Step 1 clearly show that the film was "directed and produced by Ken Burns" and lists Geoffrey C. Ward only as the "Written by" (author/co-author of the script). The Planner failed to distinguish between the director and the writer, leading to the retrieval of the wrong person's birthplace (Newark, Ohio) instead of the correct director (Ken Burns), who was born in San Francisco, California.
